name: Windows 2.0
tagline: Dithering, abandoned: Windows 2.0 just used the cyan straight.
description: Windows 2.0 (1987) added overlapping windows and a more capable interface — and quietly retired its predecessor's dithered desktop. Where Windows 1.0 blended green and cyan into a shimmering shade the hardware couldn't name, 2.0 simply took the cyan (#57ffff) and painted the desktop with it directly.

colors.name: Aqua
colors.note: The Windows 2.0 desktop. This is the cyan that Windows 1.0 used as one of its two dither colors — Windows 2.0 dropped the dithering and painted the desktop with it directly.
